# Pipeline Overview

The BMF processing pipeline is organized into **10 sequential phases**, each with a specific responsibility. The pipeline is orchestrated by `R/00_irs_bmf.R`.

## 10-Phase Pipeline

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 8
flowchart TB
    subgraph Phase1["Phase 1: Extraction"]
        A1[Download 4 Regional CSVs] --> A2[Merge into Single BMF]
        A2 --> A3[Save Raw Combined File]
    end

    subgraph Phase2["Phase 2: Pre-Validation"]
        B1[Validate Column Structure] --> B2[Check Row Count]
        B2 --> B3[Detect Duplicates]
    end

    subgraph Phase3["Phase 3: Identity"]
        C1[EIN] --> C2[Organization Name]
        C2 --> C3[ICO Name]
        C3 --> C4[Group Exemption]
        C4 --> C5[Ruling Date]
    end

    subgraph Phase4["Phase 4: Classification"]
        D1[Subsection/Classification] --> D2[Affiliation]
        D2 --> D3[Deductibility]
        D3 --> D4[Foundation]
        D4 --> D5[Organization]
        D5 --> D6[Status]
    end

    subgraph Phase5["Phase 5: Activity"]
        E1[Activity Codes] --> E2[NTEE Codes]
    end

    subgraph Phase6["Phase 6: Temporal"]
        F1[Tax Period] --> F2[Accounting Period]
    end

    subgraph Phase7["Phase 7: Financial"]
        G1[Asset Code] --> G2[Income Code]
        G2 --> G3[Asset Amount]
        G3 --> G4[Income Amount]
        G4 --> G5[Revenue Amount]
    end

    subgraph Phase8["Phase 8: Filing"]
        H1[Filing Requirement] --> H2[PF Filing Requirement]
    end

    subgraph Phase9["Phase 9: Post-Validation"]
        I1[Quality Metrics] --> I2[Generate Report]
    end

    subgraph Phase10["Phase 10: Output"]
        J1[Save Fact Table] --> J2[Save Dimension Tables]
    end

    Phase1 --> Phase2
    Phase2 --> Phase3
    Phase3 --> Phase4
    Phase4 --> Phase5
    Phase5 --> Phase6
    Phase6 --> Phase7
    Phase7 --> Phase8
    Phase8 --> Phase9
    Phase9 --> Phase10
```

## Phase Details

### Phase 1: Extraction

Downloads BMF data from the IRS website. The IRS publishes the BMF as 4 regional CSV files:

| Region | URL | ~Records |
|--------|-----|----------|
| Northeast | `eo1.csv` | 475K |
| Mid-Atlantic | `eo2.csv` | 475K |
| Gulf & Pacific Coast | `eo3.csv` | 475K |
| International/PR | `eo4.csv` | 475K |

The pipeline:
1. Downloads all 4 files to `data/raw/`
2. Combines them into a single data.table
3. Saves the combined raw file as `bmf_2025.csv`

### Phase 2: Pre-Transformation Validation

Validates the raw data before any transformations:

- **Column Check**: Ensures all 27 required columns exist
- **Row Count**: Verifies ~1.9M rows (within 5% tolerance)
- **Duplicate Detection**: Counts duplicate EINs
- **NULL Inventory**: Reports NULL counts per column

If validation fails in strict mode, the pipeline stops.

### Phase 3: Identity Transformations

Transforms organization identification fields:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `transform_ein()` | EIN | `ein`, `ein_raw` |
| `transform_organization_name()` | NAME | `org_name_raw`, `org_name_join`, `org_name_display`, `org_legal_suffix` |
| `transform_ico_name()` | ICO | `in_care_of_name_raw`, `in_care_of_name_clean`, `in_care_of_name_provided` |
| `transform_group_exemption_number()` | GROUP | `group_exemption_number_raw`, `group_exemption_number`, `group_exemption_is_member` |
| `transform_ruling_date()` | RULING | `ruling_date_ym_str`, `ruling_date`, `ruling_date_is_missing` |

### Phase 4: Classification Transformations

Adds IRS classification codes with human-readable definitions:

| Transform | Lookup Table | Outputs |
|-----------|--------------|---------|
| `transform_subsection_classification_codes()` | `classification_subsection_code_lookup.csv` | `subsection_code`, `classification_code`, `exempt_organization_type`, `all_classifications_string` |
| `transform_affiliation_code()` | `affiliation_code_lookup.csv` | `affiliation_code`, `affiliation_code_definition` |
| `transform_deductibility_code()` | `deductibility_code_lookup.csv` | `deductibility_code`, `deductibility_code_definition` |
| `transform_foundation_code()` | `foundation_code_lookup.csv` | `foundation_code`, `foundation_code_definition` |
| `transform_organization_code()` | `organization_code_lookup.csv` | `organization_code`, `organization_code_definition` |
| `transform_status_code()` | `bmf_code_lookup.xlsx` | `status_code`, `status_code_definition` |

### Phase 5: Activity Transformations

Creates dimension tables for multi-valued activity fields:

| Transform | Pattern | Outputs |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| `create_activity_code_dim_table()` | SCD Type 2 | `dim_activity_2025.parquet` |
| `transform_activity_code()` | Aggregate | `activity_code_definitions`, `activity_code_categories` |
| `transform_ntee_code()` | Complex | `ntee_code`, `ntee_code_definition`, `ntee_code_major_group`, `naics_code`, `nteev2_code`, etc. |

### Phase 6: Temporal Transformations

Parses date and period fields:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `transform_tax_period()` | TAX_PERIOD | `tax_period_ymd`, `tax_period_is_missing` |
| `transform_accounting_period()` | ACCT_PD | `accounting_period_code`, `accounting_period_definition` |

### Phase 7: Financial Transformations

Processes financial codes and amounts:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `transform_asset_code()` | ASSET_CD | `asset_code`, `asset_code_definition` |
| `transform_income_code()` | INCOME_CD | `income_code`, `income_code_definition` |
| `transform_asset_amount()` | ASSET_AMT | `asset_amount` |
| `transform_income_amount()` | INCOME_AMT | `income_amount` |
| `transform_revenue_amount()` | REVENUE_AMT | `revenue_amount` |

### Phase 8: Filing Requirement Transformations

Adds filing requirement classifications:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `transform_code()` | FILING_REQ_CD | `filing_requirement_code`, `filing_requirement_code_definition` |
| `transform_code()` | PF_FILING_REQ_CD | `pf_filing_requirement_code`, `pf_filing_requirement_code_definition` |

### Phase 9: Post-Transformation Validation

Generates a comprehensive quality report:

- Row preservation check (input rows = output rows)
- Completeness rates for all columns
- Critical field validation (EIN, subsection_code)
- Summary statistics

### Phase 10: Output

Saves final outputs to `data/processed/`:

- `bmf_2025_processed.parquet` - Main fact table
- `dim_activity_2025.parquet` - Activity dimension table
- `dim_classification_2025.parquet` - Classification dimension table
- Quality report to `data/quality/`

## Checkpoint System

The pipeline saves intermediate results as Parquet files after each major phase:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    subgraph Checkpoints
        CP1[01_raw] --> CP2[02_identity]
        CP2 --> CP3[03_classification]
        CP3 --> CP4[04_activity]
        CP4 --> CP5[05_temporal]
        CP5 --> CP6[06_financial]
        CP6 --> CP7[07_filing]
    end
```

| Checkpoint | Location | After Phase |
|------------|----------|-------------|
| `01_raw` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_2025_01_raw.parquet` | Extraction |
| `02_identity` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_2025_02_identity.parquet` | Identity |
| `03_classification` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_2025_03_classification.parquet` | Classification |
| `04_activity` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_2025_04_activity.parquet` | Activity |
| `05_temporal` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_2025_05_temporal.parquet` | Temporal |
| `06_financial` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_2025_06_financial.parquet` | Financial |
| `07_filing` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_2025_07_filing.parquet` | Filing |

**Benefits:**
- Resume from failure without reprocessing
- Debug specific phases
- Compare intermediate states

To resume from a checkpoint:
```r
bmf <- load_checkpoint("03_classification")
# Continue processing from Phase 4
```

## Configuration

Key configuration in `R/config.R`:

```r
# Pipeline settings
ENABLE_CHECKPOINTS <- TRUE       # Save intermediate results
STRICT_QUALITY_GATES <- TRUE     # Stop on validation failure
PROCESSING_YEAR <- "2025"        # Year being processed

# IRS source URLs
bmf_2025_url_ls <- list(
  northeast_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo1.csv",
  mid.atlantic_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo2.csv",
  gulf.and.pacific.coast_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo3.csv",
  international.pr_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo4.csv"
)
```
